newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Oct domestic output up 40.3% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Honda Oct domestic output up 40.3% yr/yr.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas output in October were as follows (comparisons are with year ago):
Honda's domestic output rose in October for the fourth successive month on a year-on-year basis, mainly due to higher domestic sales and an increase in exports of Civics to North America.

Honda's domestic sales rose for the 22nd successive month on a year-on-year basis, due to robust demand for its recreational vehicles Odyssey, Step Wagon, CR-V, Accord Wagon and Orthia, and its new compact hatchback Logo.
Exports rose for the second straight month, due to strong demand for Civic sedans in North America.
Overseas production rose for the ninth successive month due to higher output in North America and Asia.
